member_group_id.description: Reference to the MemberGroup this vacancy belongs to

posted_by_member_id.description: Reference to the Member (group admin) who posted this vacancy

role_title.description: Title of the position being advertised

commitment_value.description: Numeric value of the time commitment for the role

term_value.description: Numeric value of the term of office

term_unit.description: Unit for the term of office value

max_terms.description: Maximum number of terms a person can serve in this role

status.description: Whether this vacancy is open for applications or closed

application_form_id.description: Optional reference to the Form (flagged is_job_posting) used to collect applications. When set, 'Express interest' opens that form pre-filled with the member. When null, the legacy optional-message express-interest flow is used.

applicants_viewed_at.description: Timestamp the group admin last opened the submissions review modal for this vacancy. Drives the 'new entry' indicator on the posting card.
